reviews.comment: Your class grade is based on 4 tests, yes 4 tests NOT 3 and a final. Each test is 20% of your grade. But she posts a review packet on canvas with questions similar to the exam and you go over all the short answer question prompts (typically 10) in class the lecture before the exam. Don't freak out if short answer isn't your thing, MC 70% & SA 30%.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Ms. Quailes is an incredible instructor. The course is chemistry heavy, however, Ms. Quailes conducts lecture in a way that makes the concepts easy to understand. She also provides intuitive examples that help with further clarification. She is incredibly caring and genuinely wants to see her students succeed!

Professor Quailes is super sweet and knowledgeable about food science. The entire course is made up of four exams, and she gives you a review to help you study for them. Although the class is completely online, Professor Quailes and her teaching assistant make a point to engage with students who post in the (not graded) discussion forums. 10/10!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class! Professor Quailes is a great lecturer and it is evident that she puts effort into actually making the class interesting for her students. The tests are very doable, but they are the only grades for the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There are a lot of lectures but that is pretty much a given for any online class. There are only four grades, but if you do the work and the discussions a good grade is very possible. Professor Quailes is very passionate about the course which makes it more interesting, and you will learn so many fun things. Definitely take her if you can!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super chill, took it online and only had to do the 4 exams. 100% reccomend

Pretty good prof. Class can be kind of tough because it is only graded by 4 exams, which are each 20% of your final grade. Just be sure to watch the lectures and use the resources provided, and it should be pretty easy to get an "A".
Great Professor! Class is super interesting. Food science is a cool topic.
